547749.Description: [Activate Battle] [Your Turn] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +20000 power for the battle. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

562370.Description: [On Play] Choose all of your opponent's Battle Cards and they get -10000 power for the turn.

562371.Description: [When Attacking] At the end of the turn, place this card at the bottom of your deck.

615532.Description: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 "Krillin" or up to 1 "Android 17" and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

615536.Description: [When Attacking] At the end of the turn, place this card at the bottom of its owner's deck.

615538.Description: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, play up to 1 "Android 18" with a cost of 3 or less from your Drop.
